## Overview

This collected Braintree article is an exploration map for readers who have covered the basics. It links to eight support topics and gives each a short orientation: fraud tools, PCI compliance, the Control Panel, recurring billing, chargebacks and retrievals, PayPal, reporting, and risk and security.

The one-line descriptions are evidence only for what this page itself says. The outbound links are navigation routes, not evidence for the linked articles' procedures, eligibility, configuration, current availability or complete behavior.

## Key takeaways

- The page characterizes Braintree's fraud-tools route as covering chargeback protection through AVS and CVV checks and device-data analysis. It does not explain configuration, decisioning, eligibility or outcomes.
- The page states that Braintree reduces PCI-compliance burden by securely storing customer payment data, while explicitly retaining the boundary that all merchants must be PCI compliant. The linked compliance article owns the detailed obligations.
- The Control Panel entry routes readers toward payment-option configuration, reports and API-key access. Separate entries route to recurring billing, chargebacks and retrievals, PayPal, reporting, and risk and security; their brief labels do not establish the linked guides' detailed behavior.
- The recurring-billing description is limited to automatically charging customers in monthly increments. The chargebacks-and-retrievals description says the linked article covers what they are, prevention and what to do when a customer disputes a transaction; neither description is a complete operating guide.

quotes.text: Now that we’ve covered the basics, you might be wondering: what’s next? We have a wide variety of features that can make Braintree work for you and your business. If you’re not sure where to start, take a look at some of our favorite support articles.
Fight fraud and protect yourself from chargebacks with our full suite of tools. From basic AVS and CVV checks to analyzing device data – we’ve got you covered.
While Braintree alleviates your PCI compliance burden by securely storing your customer’s payment data for you, all merchants must be PCI compliant; learn how in this article.

Configure payment options, generate reports, access your API keys, and more.


### [Recurring Billing Overview](/braintree/articles/guides/recurring-billing/overview)

Learn how to charge your customers automatically in monthly increments.


### [Chargebacks and Retrievals](/braintree/articles/risk-and-security/chargebacks-retrievals/overview)

Unfortunately, chargebacks and retrievals are a standard part of accepting payments online. In this article, learn what they are, how to prevent them, and what to do if a customer disputes a transaction.
